items.t: 12V battery warning or dead 12V battery
items.note: Often replaced free under warranty. Out of warranty, a 12V replacement runs roughly $250–$450.

items.t: Air suspension sagging or height faults
items.job: Replace leaking air spring at one corner (plus damper if it is leaking too)
items.note: From a 2024 Rivian service invoice for a 2023 R1S: rear air spring $846, rear damper $1,162, 0.5 hours to replace the corner and 1.7 hours to drain and refill the suspension fluid. Owners report about $4,000 for a pair of dampers at Rivian, and one 2023 R1T suspension compressor job at 6.6 labor hours and at least $4,650 total. Often covered under warranty.

items.t: R1T powered tonneau cover jams
items.note: From a January 2026 Rivian invoice for a 2023 R1T with a sticking tonneau cover: 0.5 hours of diagnosis plus 0.1 hours to recalibrate, billed at $138 before a goodwill discount. A failed motor or track would cost more; no parts price for those is published.

items.t: Doors that won't close flush and rattles
items.job: Adjust door or liftgate fit and replace loose seals
items.note: From Rivian invoices: 0.25 hours to replace delaminated liftgate margin seals on a 2023 R1S, 0.6 hours to replace a front door glass run seal trim on a 2022 R1T, and 2 hours for an upper liftgate adjustment on a 2024 R1S. All were done under warranty, so seal part prices were shown as $0.
